**No, the IBGE is not allowed to share data with public or private companies for generating official statistics.**

According to the document (a Law Library of Congress report on COVID-19-related data regulation), under Brazilian Provisional Measure No. 954 of April 17, 2020, the IBGE received data from telecommunications companies specifically for generating official statistics during the COVID-19 public health emergency. However, the measure explicitly prohibits the IBGE from further sharing that data:

> "The IBGE is prohibited from making the data available to any public or private companies or bodies, or to entities of the public administration of any of the federative entities." (chunk 227c2e7c, p. 18)

In other words, while the IBGE could *receive* data from telecom companies to produce official statistics, it was barred from passing that data on to any third party—whether public or private.
